enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow under head. Stretch legs. Scratch arm. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Sigh. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel.
Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Put on belt. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Put in laptop. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Put on headphones. Play music. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Put on gloves. Check patient list. Take vital signs of patient 1. Record vital signs. Administer medication to patient 1. Talk to patient 1. Move to patient 2. Take vital signs of patient 2. Record vital signs. Administer medication to patient 2. Talk to patient 2. Attend team meeting. Update patient charts. Assist doctor with procedure.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Put on headphones. Play music. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Add oil to pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Press channel up. Press volume up. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Stretch legs. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust sitting position.

Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Navigate to email. Read emails. Reply to email. Type message. Send email. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Comment on post. Close browser. Open document. Type document. Save document. Close laptop.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
